meta.face: Perpetua: about twenty-two, dark hair bound up under a white veil, a composed oval face and a direct, fearless gaze. Felicity: slightly younger, a simpler rounder face, dark hair under a plain veil, a gentle lowered gaze.
meta.basis: The Passion of Perpetua and Felicity (Perpetua about twenty-two, noble, a nursing mother; Felicity a slave who gave birth in prison; the ladder of Perpetua's vision) and the Ravenna mosaics, which dress Felicity more plainly. Their colouring is not attested. The excerpt is Perpetua's answer to the procurator.

sources.title: The Passion of Perpetua and Felicity (New Advent)
